# Connector icons

Bundled brand logos are from [Dashboard Icons by Homarr Labs](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons), under its included Apache-2.0 license. All marks belong to their respective owners and identify the connected service; they do not imply endorsement.

Source PNGs: gmail, google-drive, google-calendar, notion, figma, linear, canva, slack, asana, hubspot, microsoft. Downloaded 2026-10-03 from the project's jsDelivr CDN. Icons load from the app bundle without runtime network requests.

Canva uses its official favicon at https://static.canva.com/static/images/favicon-1.ico (converted to PNG). HubSpot uses https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/HubSpot_Logos/HubSpot-Inversed-Favicon.png. Their trademarks remain their owners' property.
